name: Jev Browser
tagline: Fast browser goal execution with Jev through Vercel AI Gateway
description: Gives the agent an isolated Playwright Chromium browser and delegates bounded browser goals to `typesafe-ai/jev` through Vercel AI Gateway. `jev_run` takes a URL and a goal, observes the DOM, picks one offered action per step in a fast loop, and returns before/after screenshots plus a JSONL trace. Includes manual `jev_actions`, console and network logs, a localhost live viewer, optional video recording, a navigation allowlist, and an injected safety rule that stops for consequential actions. Chromium is downloaded automatically on first load.

env.name: AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY
env.description: Vercel AI Gateway key used for Jev evaluations and the text helper model. Can also be set as gateway.apiKey in ~/.cline/plugins/cline-jev-browser.config.json.

env.name: JEV_TEXT_MODEL
env.description: Optional Gateway text model ID used to generate typed field values. Defaults to google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite.

install.notes: Restart Cline after installing. On Linux, Chromium needs system browser libraries and a working sandbox (unprivileged user namespaces).
